item.title: Show HN: Agents can shop for you, and ship to your door
item.summary: Hey everyone, over the past 6 weeks, we've been building Sangria at Founders Inc. We think agents can make shopping 1000x better, since they have so much context about you, and your preferences. They could predict when your milk is going to run out and prompt you to order again. We wanted to build this future where agents can actually shop for you irl! Do try now, our most popular mode of usage is via the iMessage bot!
